name: cathedral
description: Rent confidential compute from cathedral.computer — attested Intel TDX CPU jobs, sealed persistent workers, and confidential GPU executions, each returning a signed receipt binding evidence, workload, result, charge and teardown. BYOK: every run is billed to the caller's own prepaid Cathedral credits, never a shared house key.

byok.note: keys are never committed, never logged, and never shared between accounts; the API refuses to serve a caller with the server's own key

billing.model: prepaid USD credits on the caller's own Cathedral account

/.docs: Module info, BYOK contract, endpoint map

/profiles.docs: Live profile catalog and runtime gates (public)

/inventory.docs: Every hardware class and buyable shape, flattened out of the catalog with its gate verdict (public)

/gpu/ready.docs: Whether the confidential-GPU gates all PASS right now (public)

/me.docs: Key fingerprint + credit balance of the paying caller

/credits/checkout.docs: Hosted Stripe URL for the caller's own top-up

/free-test.docs: The one free restricted minute per verified account

/run.docs: attest.v1 — one verified TDX CPU job ($0.20/completed execution)

/rent.docs: custom.v1 — keep a sealed worker alive (hourly), optional hybrid GPU preview

/gpu.docs: cc_gpu — one confidential GPU execution ($3.00), refused unless catalog gates PASS

/workers/:id.docs: One worker's state (completed only after teardown is confirmed)

/receipts/:id/verify.docs: Fetch the receipt with the caller's key, then verify its signature offline

/receipts/verify.docs: Verify a receipt you already hold against the pinned trusted keys (public — no key needed)

/receipts/trusted-keys.docs: Cathedral's published ed25519 receipt-signing keys as pinned here (public)

app.serves: zero-dependency console: full compute inventory + gates, quoted spend guard, jobs, workers, receipts, offline receipt verification, credits
app.keys: held in the browser tab (sessionStorage) and sent as Authorization; never stored, logged, or proxied elsewhere

env.CATHEDRAL_API_KEY: cat_sk_* key for the default CLI account (optional — the API gateway never uses it for callers)
env.CATHEDRAL_BASE: override the upstream base URL (default https://cathedral.computer/v1)
env.CATHEDRAL_TRUSTED_KEYS: where the API gateway pins Cathedral's receipt-signing keys (default ~/.mod/cathedral/trusted-keys.json)
